bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using Large Language Models (LLMs) to identify sexist language in text and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to detect visual imbalances and stereotypes in images (e.g., analyzing generated captions and visual features for representational disparities, as demonstrated in the platform's case studies).

Evaluated via the framework's multimodal pipeline, which uses LLMs for text analysis (sentiment evaluation and keyword detection) and VLMs for image interpretation to flag racist content and harmful stereotypes.

Addressed as part of the general framework's natural language understanding and visual feature analysis, which aims to identify and mitigate unfair treatment based on protected demographic characteristics.
